title: Core Definitions
purpose: Consolidate canonical definitions and protected distinctions without becoming a competing definition site.
must_include: definition table | primary definition location | non-equivalences | authority boundary
must_exclude: new definitions | new PMS primitives | person typing | new operation

title: Formal Notation
purpose: Provide notation for objects, coordinates, occurrences, chains, loss, and admissibility while preserving prose precedence.
must_include: typed object notation | frame/granularity/level notation | operation-occurrence notation | chain notation | loss notation | status of formulas
must_exclude: proof of completeness | numerical scoring | new semantics | category-theoretic claims not already defined

title: Shared Transformation Record Schema
purpose: Explain the shared record contract and its relation to the formal schema without duplicating or overriding the schema owner.
must_include: field groups | required declarations | loss fields | route/output separation | schema-authority boundary
must_exclude: substantive truth automation | new fields not in schema | merged chain records

title: COMPOSE Record Template
purpose: Provide a usable COMPOSE occurrence template derived from the shared schema and operation registry.
must_include: source multiplicity/order | constitutive relations | selection | composite identity | loss | no automatic target function
must_exclude: lossless inversion | automatic trajectory status | automatic higher authority

title: DECOMPOSE Record Template
purpose: Provide a usable DECOMPOSE occurrence template derived from the shared schema and operation registry.
must_include: same reference object | resolution change | reconstructed relations | residual binding | loss | stop/non-capture
must_exclude: operator-type decomposition | finer-is-truer rule | hidden RETYPE | lossless inverse

title: PROJECT_AS Record Template
purpose: Provide a usable PROJECT_AS occurrence template derived from the shared schema and operation registry.
must_include: origin type | target function | target context | counterfactual sensitivity | contextual boundedness | type integrity
must_exclude: origin-type replacement | label substitution | analogy as projection | authority inheritance

title: Admissibility Band Tests
purpose: Operationalize lower/upper band tests and their non-compensatory relation without replacing local judgment.
must_include: PraxisPurchase | TraceableLoad | TypeIntegrity | continuity | counterfactual sensitivity | source/claim ceilings | stop/non-capture
must_exclude: numeric scoring | compensatory weighting | automatic class ranking | truth proof

title: Valid and Invalid Transformation Patterns
purpose: Collect recurring admissible and invalid patterns without creating new operations or classes.
must_include: positive patterns | failure patterns | claim reduction patterns | stop patterns | non-capture contrast
must_exclude: case ranking | universal inference from examples | new theory

title: Boundary and Confusion Cases
purpose: Consolidate load-bearing collision boundaries and confusion routes across operations and output classes.
must_include: operation collisions | output-class boundaries | same-source contrasts where available | stop versus failure versus non-capture

title: Optional Operator-Weighting and Trajectory Stress Tests
purpose: Provide optional stress vectors for weighting profiles, trajectories, branches, alternatives, and path dependence.
must_include: weighting as configuration profile | trajectory/path distinctions | historical alternative status | false-trajectory contrasts
must_exclude: new operators | renamed Δ–Ψ dependencies | formal weight scoring | historical branch invention

title: Cross-Domain Projection and Analogy Stress Tests
purpose: Stress-test PROJECT_AS against analogy, recontextualization, and cross-domain label transfer.
must_include: source-sensitive projection | analogy-only route | label-substitution failure | contextual boundedness
must_exclude: analogy as proof | domain authority transfer | origin-type replacement

title: Non-Operator Remainders and Limits of Decomposition
purpose: Consolidate remainders, residual binding, source-function limits, stop, and genuine non-capture under DECOMPOSE.
must_include: non-operator remainder | residual relation | source-function return | granularity stop | genuine non-capture
must_exclude: operator-type decomposition | unbounded microdetail | non-capture as weak-claim shield

title: Case and Countercase Index
purpose: Provide a publishable, human-readable index into paired Records and package narratives.
must_include: case class | operation | output class | source/target summary | record/package links | coverage role
must_exclude: new adjudication | case ranking | duplicate full case narratives

title: Integrated STRATA Audit Template
purpose: Provide the full twelve-stage audit and chain handoff template without making machine validity substantive truth.
must_include: twelve audit stages | candidate generation | collision adjudication | output mapping | loss/stop/failure preservation | chain handoff
must_exclude: audit stage 13 | automatic substantive finding | merged local results | authority inheritance
